name: agentic-ui-a11y
$comment: This file exists for one reason: "type": "module". @a11y-scout/playwright and a11y-scout are both ESM-only, the repository root package.json declares no "type" and so defaults to CommonJS, and without this the specs here fail to load. It is NOT an npm workspace member - the root declares no "workspaces" - and it is NOT an Nx project. Nothing installs from it; a11y-scout and @playwright/test are installed at the root with --no-save, which is why package-lock.json is untouched by this folder.
